title: Graph learning-assisted logic-based Benders decomposition for distributionally robust in-station train rescheduling under disruptions
abstract: arXiv:2611.07520v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Uncertainty in resource reopening times complicates train holding and rerouting decisions when resource closures coincide with arrival delays and processing-time extensions. We develop a rolling-horizon distributionally robust model that updates predictions of the remaining closure duration as observations of disruption resolution become available. The model jointly optimizes train routes, sequences, and timings. It minimizes the worst-case expected total completion delay over an ambiguity set of scenario probabilities. The solution algorithm, GNN-LBBD, uses logic-based Benders decomposition to coordinate routing and resource scheduling. Conditional cuts are constructed from resource-use patterns, and a graph neural network guides the order in which resource relaxation subproblems are solved. translated_title: 面向中断情况下分布鲁棒站内列车重调度的图学习辅助逻辑Benders分解方法
translated_abstract: 当资源关闭与列车到达延误和处理时间延长同时发生时，资源重新开放时间的不确定性使列车扣停和改线决策变得复杂。我们开发了一个滚动时域分布鲁棒模型，该模型能够随着中断恢复情况观测信息的不断获取，更新对剩余关闭时长的预测。该模型联合优化列车走行路径、运行顺序和时刻安排，并在场景概率的模糊集上最小化最坏情况下的期望总完成延误。所提出的求解算法GNN-LBBD采用基于逻辑的Benders分解来协调路径规划与资源调度：条件割平面基于资源使用模式构建，并由图神经网络引导资源松弛子问题的求解顺序。在针对五股道车站的28个测试实例中，GNN-LBBD实现了61.13列车分钟的平均总完成延误，比（对比方法）降低了16.63%。
tldr: 本文提出GNN-LBBD算法，将图神经网络与基于逻辑的Benders分解相结合，求解中断情况下站内列车重调度的滚动时域分布鲁棒优化模型，使平均总完成延误较对比方法降低16.63%。
